scoring: log-probability of ' <label>]' after the prefix '[Niveau de priorité estimé :', raw (no calibration by empty prompt)
cost_matrix_rows: annotated level (P1, P2, P3); columns = predicted level
alpha_applies_to: under-triage cells (upper triangle) of the cost matrix
decision: argmin over predicted levels of softmax(logp / temperature) @ cost_alpha
chosen_on: validation split (best macro F1 and accuracy among alpha in 0.25..3)
